name: CADRE
def: Set of three suitcase sized solar rovers built to explore the Moon as an autonomous team sharing a single radar measurement.
body: CADRE is a technology demonstration of multi robot autonomy in which three identical four wheeled rovers elect a leader, divide up a survey area and drive without step by step commands from Earth. Each carries stereo cameras and an antenna for a multistatic ground penetrating radar that only works when several rovers cooperate, building a three dimensional picture of the subsurface. The flight rovers are complete and are to reach the Reiner Gamma region aboard the Intuitive Machines IM-3 lander, working for about one lunar day.
facts: Three rovers designed to work as an autonomous team
Radar measurement requires several rovers operating together
Flight hardware built and awaiting launch on IM-3
specs: Four wheel drive with independent steering on each rover
Solar panel with rechargeable battery on each rover
Stereo cameras, sun sensors, multistatic ground penetrating radar
Distributed multi agent planning over mesh radio with an elected leader
